41136-a-plucky-girl.title: A Plucky Girl
41136-a-plucky-girl.creator: Mrs. L. T. Meade
41136-a-plucky-girl.description: A book by Mrs. L. T. Meade. and always pronounced it slowly. She was devoted to father, and never spoke of him as most people do of their dead, but as if he were still living, and close to her and to me. When a very little child, my greatest treat was to sit on her knee and listen to wonderful stories of my brave and gallant father.

arxiv-2104-14058.title: Characterization of k k -positive maps
arxiv-2104-14058.creator: Tomasz Młynik, Hiroyuki Osaka, Marcin Marciniak
arxiv-2104-14058.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tomasz Młynik, Hiroyuki Osaka, Marcin Marciniak. We present a general characterization of k-positivity for a positive map in terms of the estimation of the Ky Fan norm of the matrix constructed from the Kraus operators of the associated completely positive map. Combining this with the result given by Takasaki and Tomiyama we construct a family of positive maps between matrix algebras of different dimensions depending on a parameter.

arxiv-2210-08226.title: Self-Distillation for Unsupervised 3D Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2210-08226.creator: Adriano Cardace, Riccardo Spezialetti, Pierluigi Zama Ramirez, Luigi Di Stefano
arxiv-2210-08226.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Adriano Cardace, Riccardo Spezialetti, Pierluigi Zama Ramirez, Luigi Di Stefano. Point cloud classification is a popular task in 3D vision. However, previous works, usually assume that point clouds at test time are obtained with the same procedure or sensor as those at training time. Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) instead, breaks this assumption and tries to solve the task on an unlabeled target domain, leveraging only on a supervised source domain.

arxiv-2212-14319.title: Gaussian Process Priors for Systems of Linear Partial Differential Equations with Constant Coefficients
arxiv-2212-14319.creator: Marc Härkönen, Markus Lange-Hegermann, Bogdan Raiță
arxiv-2212-14319.description: Abstract Partial differential equations (PDEs) are important tools to model physical systems and including them into machine learning models is an important way of incorporating physical knowledge. Given any system of linear PDEs with constant coefficients, we propose a family of Gaussian process (GP) priors, which we call EPGP, such that all realizations are exact solutions of this system.

arxiv-2304-12722.title: Godbillon-Vey Invariants of Non-Lorentzian Spacetimes and Aristotelian Hydrodynamics
arxiv-2304-12722.creator: Vincenzo Emilio Marotta, Richard J. Szabo
arxiv-2304-12722.description: Abstract . We study the geometry of foliated non-Lorentzian spacetimes in terms of the Godbillon-Vey class of the foliation. We relate the intrinsic torsion of a foliated Aristotelian manifold to its Godbillon-Vey class, and interpret it as a measure of the local spin of the spatial leaves in the time direction.

arxiv-2506-06583.title: Time Delay of Pulsar Signals in Astrophysical Black Hole Spacetimes
arxiv-2506-06583.creator: Parth Bambhaniya, Viraj Kalsariya, Saurabh, Elisabete M. de Gouveia Dal Pino, Ivan De Martino, Riccardo Della Monica, Mariafelicia De Laurentis
arxiv-2506-06583.description: Abstract Context. In this paper, we investigate the fully relativistic time delay of pulsar signals propagating in the vicinity of a rotating black hole and its potential mimickers, including a deformed Kerr black hole and the Janis-Newman-Winicour naked singularity. Aims.

arxiv-2506-11910.title: The Moduli Stack of Breuil–Kisin Modules with Descent Data for Reductive Groups
arxiv-2506-11910.creator: Eivind Otto Hjelle
arxiv-2506-11910.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Eivind Otto Hjelle. We introduce and study the moduli stack 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} of Breuil–Kisin modules with G ^ \widehat{G} -structure and descent data, or Breuil–Kisin ( Γ , G ^ ) (\Gamma,\widehat{G}) -torsors for short. Specifically, for a dominant cocharacter μ \mu , we define the moduli stack 𝒴 ≤ μ \mathcal{Y}^{\leq\mu} of Breuil–Kisin ( Γ , G ^ ) (\Gamma,\widehat{G}) -torsors with Hodge–Tate weights bounded by μ \mu .

arxiv-2508-01290.title: Prompting Large Language Models with Partial Knowledge for Answering Questions with Unseen Entities DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Information systems Question answering CCS: Computing methodologies Discourse, dialogue and pragmatics
arxiv-2508-01290.creator: Zhichao Yan, Jiapu Wang, Jiaoyan Chen, Yanyan Wang, Hongye Tan, Jiye Liang, Xiaoli Li, Ru Li, Jeff Z.Pan
arxiv-2508-01290.description: Abstract . Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shows impressive performance by supplementing and substituting parametric knowledge in Large Language Models (LLMs). Retrieved knowledge can be divided into three types: explicit answer evidence, implicit answer clue, and insufficient answer context which can be further categorized into totally irrelevant and partially relevant information.

pmc-10568402.title: Toward Personalized Medicine Approaches for Parkinson Disease Using Digital Technologies
pmc-10568402.creator: Amit Khanna, Graham Jones, Amaryllis Mavragani, Karen Van Ooteghem, Sayan Mitra
pmc-10568402.description: Parkinson disease (PD) is a complex neurodegenerative disorder that afflicts over 10 million people worldwide, resulting in debilitating motor and cognitive impairment. In the United States alone (with approximately 1 million cases), the economic burden for treating and caring for persons with PD exceeds US $50 billion and myriad therapeutic approaches are under development, including both symptomatic- and disease-modifying agents.

pmc-11676812.title: Unexpected Genetic Diversity of Nostocales (Cyanobacteria) Isolated from the Phyllosphere of the Laurel Forests in the Canary Islands (Spain)
pmc-11676812.creator: Nereida M. Rancel-Rodríguez, Nicole Sausen, Carolina P. Reyes, Antera Martel Quintana, Barbara Melkonian, Michael Melkonian
pmc-11676812.description: A total of 96 strains of Nostocales (Cyanobacteria) were established from the phyllosphere of the laurel forests in the Canary Islands (Spain) and the Azores (Portugal) using enrichment media lacking combined nitrogen. The strains were characterized by light microscopy and SSU rRNA gene comparisons. Morphologically, most strains belonged to two different morphotypes, termed “Nostoc-type” and “Tolypothrix-type”.

pmc-11714947.title: A web‐based tool for early prediction of Alzheimer’s disease dementia based on magnetic resonance imaging data
pmc-11714947.creator: Yong Fan
pmc-11714947.description: BackgroundRecent studies have demonstrated that deep learning of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) brain scans can accurately predict Alzheimer’s disease (AD) dementia and cognitive decline. However, the translational potential of this technique remains unfulfilled, as the underlying deep learning techniques are not yet available for immediate clinical use.

pmc-12446476.title: The bactericidal FabI inhibitor Debio 1453 clears antibiotic-resistant Neisseria gonorrhoeae infection in vivo
pmc-12446476.creator: Vincent Gerusz, Pierre Regenass, Quentin Rousseau, Victor Moraine, Justine Dao, Xavier Lavé, Shampa Das, Josée Hue Perron, Laurence Fajas Descamps, Juan Bravo, Guennaëlle Dieppois, Nachum Kaplan, Matthew Lefebre, Deanna Altomari, Vladimir Romanov, Terry Finn, Pierre Daram, Francesca Bernardini, Mich
pmc-12446476.description: Gonorrhoea is a prevalent sexually transmitted infection caused by the bacterial pathogen Neisseria gonorrhoeae. N. gonorrhoeae has demonstrated a remarkable capacity to evolve antibiotic resistance, with emerging strains that show resistance to all standard treatment options. The development of new antibiotics for gonorrhoea, especially those with novel targets and no pre-existing resistance, is critical.

pmc-12522622.title: Use of two virtual dissection tables in a postgraduate oral anatomy course: feedback from the students
pmc-12522622.creator: Davide Gerardi, Diana Torge, Sara Bernardi, Serena Bianchi, Guido Macchiarelli
pmc-12522622.description: BackgroundAdvancements in medical education technologies transformed the teaching and learning of several disciplines, including human anatomy, which is considered the core of health sciences education. Recent technological innovations, including virtual dissection tables like the Anatomage® and SECTRA® table, provided interactive 3D models and clinical imaging that address these limitations.

pmc-13054878.title: Advancing from Compliance to Innovation in Medical Education: a strategic roadmap for MEUs in colleges of Korean medicine based on FGI
pmc-13054878.creator: Min Jung Lee, Hye-Yoon Lee, Myung Ho Jin, Seon Kyoung Kim
pmc-13054878.description: ObjectivesThis study sought to develop a strategic, phased roadmap for advancing Medical Education Units (MEUs) in colleges of Korean Medicine, grounded in qualitative insights derived from focus group interviews (FGIs) and contextualized within the existing literature.MethodsQualitative data were obtained from key stakeholders across 12 institutions. Data were analyzed using thematic analysis guided by a goal-oriented, competency-based framework.

pmc-13134934.title: Rare clinical image of chronic bilateral lymphatic filariasis with secondary bilateral hip osteonecrosis
pmc-13134934.creator: Sakshi Shankarrao Waghmare, Subrat Samal
pmc-13134934.description: are crucial to prevent irreversible hip destruction. This case highlights the rare association of chronic lymphatic filariasis with bilateral femoral head osteonecrosis, the limited benefit of core decompression in advanced disease. A 52-year-old male, known case of bilateral lymphatic filariasis for forty years, presented with progressive dull aching pain in the right hip and difficulty in ambulation for one year.

pmc-13191298.title: From gene correlations to cell clusters: COTAN improved scRNA-seq analysis
pmc-13191298.creator: Silvia Giulia Galfrè, Marco Fantozzi, Alina Sîrbu, Irene Testa, Matteo Tolloso, Andrea Alberti, Corrado Priami, Francesco Morandin
pmc-13191298.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) now routinely profiles thousands of individual transcriptomes, yet no consensus pipeline exists for either laboratory protocol or downstream analysis. Droplet-based datasets are especially challenging: their count matrices are extremely sparse and many biologically important genes are expressed at very low levels.

pmc-13365071.title: Dual-Task Training Improves Shoulder Function and is Associated with Changes in Sensorimotor Network Connectivity After Arthroscopic Rotator Cuff Repair: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13365071.creator: Liang Chen, Zi-Hao Jia, Peng Chen
pmc-13365071.description: BackgroundRecovery after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair (ARCR) is influenced by pain, proprioception, sensorimotor control, and psychological factors in addition to tissue healing. Cognitive–motor dual-task training may improve attentional allocation and motor control, but its role in postoperative ARCR rehabilitation remains unclear.

pmc-13460510.title: Peri‐ and Post‐Menopausal Hormone Replacement Therapy and Voice Disorder Risk: A TriNetX Study
pmc-13460510.creator: David Kayekjian, Warren B. Chun, Shaun A. Nguyen, Ashli K. O'Rourke, Kirsten D. Meenan
pmc-13460510.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesThe aim of this study was to elucidate the risk of developing voice disorders among peri‐ and post‐menopausal female hormone replacement therapy (HRT) users.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted using the TriNetX Global Collaborative Network. Females aged 40–60 years old were included and stratified into two cohorts: HRT users (n = 16,586) and HRT non‐users (n = 248,725) while excluding for head and neck radiation/neoplasms, smoking, benign laryngeal lesions, thyroid disorders, gender dysphoria, and any other systemic hormone use.

pmc-13542702.title: Postoperative Cholestasis After Uncomplicated Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy: A Case Report
pmc-13542702.creator: Sarah Y Cao, Damien J Lazar, Selmy Sabry Awad
pmc-13542702.description: IntroductionIn the absence of complications, transient jaundice has been observed in postoperative patients after abdominal surgery. This jaundice has been previously attributed to intrahepatic cholestasis due to oxidative stress from surgery and can be marked within the first postoperative weeks. However, this change has often been seen in patients with significant comorbidities.

pmc-13670849.title: Reducing overconfident errors in clinical prediction models
pmc-13670849.creator: Henry Bayly, Yorghos Tripodis, Steven Lenio, Prasad Patil
pmc-13670849.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Machine Learning (ML) models are increasingly being used in clinical workflows. Evaluation of these models tends to focus on global performance metrics, which can obscure error patterns and lead to bias in clinical decision making. Here, we propose Proximal Error-Based Confidence Adjustment (PECA), a framework designed explicitly to improve the safety of ML predictions by reducing a model’s confidence in regions of the feature space associated with historical prediction errors.
